description: List an account's invoices; ALWAYS writes the result to the caller-supplied output_tsv_path, never inline. Requires account_id. NOTE on this call's ceiling: Zuora's own pagination support for this specific endpoint (GET /v1/invoices/accounts/{account_id}) is not independently confirmed in current vendor documentation, so row_limit is applied as a cap on what is WRITTEN from Zuora's single-call response rather than a guaranteed pre-fetch ceiling -- if an account has more invoices than Zuora returns in one call, truncated may under-report. Defaults to 500 to avoid exhausting disk on an unexpectedly large account. To raise the cap, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 5000) -- both are required together, and a row_limit above 5000 is refused rather than silently clamped. Prefer selecting on stable invoice/account IDs downstream over billing-contact PII fields when the goal is validation.
embedding_description: List every invoice Zuora issued against one account -- charges, frequency, outstanding balances -- to a workspace TSV, up to 5,000 with an acknowledged override, 500 by default. Returns path, columns, row count, and a truncation flag. Survey an account's charges (get_invoice covers one known invoice in detail); prefer stable ID fields over PII for validation reads.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Zuora invoices exported to a workspace TSV
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with path (the written .tsv file in the operator's workspace), columns, row_count, and truncated (true when row_count hit the effective limit -- more invoices may exist, see the ceiling note above).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the listing: the written path, the row_count, and the column list. The file reflects sensitive financial/billing content (data_sensitivity 0.5) -- name the path for downstream use but do not inline its contents. If truncated is true, warn that the listing hit the effective limit and point to a higher acknowledged row_limit (up to 5000) if more is needed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List a Zuora account's invoices and write the result to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace, up to an acknowledged override ceiling.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing account_id/output_tsv_path, the path's parent directory does not exist, acknowledge_default_limit_override and row_limit were not given together, or row_limit exceeded the 5000 hard cap. zuora.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). zuora.object_not_found: no account with that id exists. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.invalid_params naming the override pair: pass BOTH acknowledge_default_limit_override=true and an explicit row_limit, or neither (for the 500-record default); a row_limit above 5000 is refused outright, not clamped. zuora.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root; if export_allowed_roots is empty, add the operator's export directory to the zuora_plugin config and reload the plugin config. zuora.object_not_found: verify the account_id via data_query or get_object.
